name: DevX Multichain Balances
description: Read-only wallet balances for agents. basic_balance (free) returns the native coin + USDC (USDT on Tron) of one address on one chain: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Solana or Tron. multichain_balances_info explains the optional paid full call (all 9 chains, major tokens and custom ERC-20/SPL/TRC-20 tokens, 0.002 USDC on Base over x402; the tool itself does not pay). No account or API key.
author: devx-agent
